description:
Join Our Team at Fuerda Smartech!

Are you ready to drive innovation in the automotive industry? Fuerda Smartech, a technology powerhouse with over 497 national patents, is on the hunt for an

Logistics Engineer 💻 to be part of our team.

At Fuerda Smartech, we're at the forefront of automotive technology. We specialize in designing, developing, and manufacturing mid-to-high-end automotive intelligent electronic integrated control systems, cutting-edge lighting solutions, production of air-vents, and other basic components for vehicles.

The company has three R&D centers and five manufacturing bases in Cixi, Ningbo and Shanghai; possesses a subsidiary and a R&D center in Germany to carry out synchronous design and development, marketing services and other work with overseas OEMs. In 2021, Fuerda built a production base in Romania to ensure the supply capacity to Europe as well as the rest of the world to further explore overseas markets.

Requirements:

  • University degree in Engineering, Logistics,Transportation, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a Logistics Specialist or Logistics Engineer role, preferably within the automotive manufacturing industry.
  • Advanced English language skills, both written and spoken.
  • In-depth understanding of logistics processes in a manufacturing plant.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and SAP.
  • Excellent numerical and mathematical skills, with the ability to analyze data and interpret results.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Initiative, autonomy, and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.
  • Strong documentation, organizational, and information management skills.
  • High attention to detail and a results-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities:


  • Analyze, design, and optimize logistics flows for materials, semi-finished goods, and finished products.
  • Conduct logistics assessments, including internal material supply chain analyses, time studies, route analyses, and baseline assessments.
  • Define and implement logistics flows for new projects and changes to existing manufacturing processes.
  • Design and organize logistics areas according to operational needs and manufacturing process requirements.
  • Manage logistics capacity by determining storage capacities and establishing maximum permitted stock levels.
  • Assess the impact of volume fluctuations on logistics operations and propose appropriate adaptation and optimization solutions.
  • Participate in the implementation and development of WMS, MES, and ERP systems.
  • Create, update, and maintain databases and reports containing relevant logistics management information for various programs.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

Benefits: 

  • The 13-th salary – Paid once a year;
  • Annual performance bonus (up to 10% of the gross annual salary, based on achieving the KPIs set in the previous year);
  • Meal tickets - With a value of 35 Lei and Benefit platform;
  • Christmas and Easter bonuses in gift vouchers;
  • Meal discounts for catering 15 lei brut;
  • Private Medical Services - Health is the most important, so we offer you a medical subscription through Medlife – Business package; SanoPass;
  • Company loyalty bonus (50% of your monthly salary after 5 years, and 100% after 10 years);
  • Referral bonuses - We encourage colleagues to refer new candidates to us and, at the same time, to get the chance to receive a bonus;
  • Extra vacation days – You start with 25 days of annual leave from day one (instead of the legal 20-day minimum);
  • Transport on predetermined routes.


Your expertise will drive us forward! We`re excting to meet you!
